title: Thiacalix[4]arene-Supported Kite-Like Heterometallic Tetranuclear ZnIILnIII3 (Ln = Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho) Complexes

material_class.structural_family: kite-like tetranuclear ZnLn3 cluster capped by two tail-to-tail p-tert-butylthiacalix[4]arene ligands

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of H4BTC4A·CHCl3 (0.12 mmol, 82 mg), Zn(OAc)2·2H2O (0.46 mmol, 100 mg), and Ln(OAc)3·6H2O (0.22 mmol, 100 mg; Ln = Gd for 1) in DMA/CH3OH (5/5 mL) was sealed in a 25 mL Teflon-lined bomb at 120 °C for 3 days and then cooled slowly at 4 °C h−1 to room temperature. Colorless prismatic crystals were isolated by filtration, washed with DMA/CH3OH (1:1, v/v), and air-dried.
synthesis.temperature: 120 °C, then cooled at 4 °C h−1 to room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal synthesis in 25 mL Teflon-lined bomb
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: colorless prismatic crystals isolated by filtration, washed with DMA/CH3OH (1:1, v/v), and air-dried

properties.summary: χmT at 300 K is 23.13 cm3 K mol−1, close to three uncoupled GdIII ions; χmT remains roughly constant to 50 K then drops to 11.80 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, consistent with intramolecular antiferromagnetic Gd···Gd coupling. Curie–Weiss fit and HDVV modeling give small negative J values. Magnetization saturates at 20.75 Nβ (2 K, 80 kOe), matching 21 Nβ expected for three GdIII; no hysteresis and no frequency-dependent ac signals above 2 K.

properties.summary: H4BTC4A is an efficient sensitizer for Tb3+: excitation at 350 nm gives intense green 5D4→7FJ emission at 489, 545, 586, and 620 nm with complete quenching of ligand fluorescence, Φoverall = 29.80%, and biexponential 5D4 lifetimes 1.09 ms (93.26%) and 0.25 ms (6.14%). Magnetically, χmT = 35.81 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, dropping to 15.74 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K; Mmax = 24.33 Nβ at 2 K/80 kOe, below the 27 Nβ Tb3 sum, with non-superimposed M vs H/T curves indicating anisotropy. No SMM ac signals above 2 K.

properties.summary: Room-temperature emission (λex = 365 nm) shows ligand fluorescence at 407 nm plus Dy3+ bands at 479 and 572 nm (4F9/2→6H15/2, 6H13/2); ligand sensitization is inefficient and lifetime/QY were too weak to measure. Magnetically, χmT = 41.12 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, falling to 25.38 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K; Mmax = 21.53 Nβ at 2 K/80 kOe (below 30 Nβ). Zero-dc-field ac susceptibility shows frequency-dependent in- and out-of-phase signals typical of SMM slow relaxation with a rather small barrier; no obvious hysteresis.

properties.summary: χmT = 39.23 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K (expected 42.21 for three HoIII), then decreases gradually and falls rapidly to 8.02 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, attributed to thermal depopulation of HoIII Stark sublevels and possible antiferromagnetic interactions/anisotropy. Magnetization reaches 22.48 Nβ at 2 K/80 kOe, below 30 Nβ; M vs H/T curves are not superimposed. No hysteresis and no frequency-dependent ac signals above 2 K.
